model.wall: post-streaming bounce-back at rows 0 and ny-1; SC wall treatment dry (baseline) vs mirror (neutral wetting)

c1_interface.convention: halfway wall plane (H=ny-2, h=half-0.5); calibrated by --mode walls

c3_spurious.reason: parasitic current of the Shan-Chen two-component model at |G12|=2.5 is S=O(1e-2) lattice units, resolution independent (9.3e-3 at ny=25, 8.6e-3 at ny=33); the ratio is set by S/u_max with u_max=O(1e-2..1e-1), so the gate 0.005 would need S<5e-4 .. 6e-4, i.e. a 4x-20x reduction the model does not deliver at any tested resolution

c4_trend.threshold: monotone |err| decrease over >=2 resolutions, same sign regime

external_anchor.analytic: two-layer co-moving Poiseuille, u''=-G/nu per layer with velocity and shear-stress continuity (cases/mcmp_stratified_poiseuille/analytic.py)
references: Shan & Doolen (1995) J. Stat. Phys. 81:379 - multicomponent SC LBM
Martys & Chen (1996) J. Comput. Phys. 126:276 - viscous coupling
Guo, Zheng & Shi (2002) Phys. Rev. E 65:046308 - second-order forcing
Krueger et al. (2017) The Lattice Boltzmann Method, Springer, ch. 9 (spurious currents at diffuse interfaces)

repro_cmd: bash cases/mcmp_stratified_poiseuille/run_r2_matrix.sh all && PYTHONPATH=src:. python cases/mcmp_stratified_poiseuille/analyze.py && PYTHONPATH=src:. python cases/mcmp_stratified_poiseuille/r2_benchmark.py
